title: opencode
intro: OpenCode, headless over `opencode run --format json`. The provider is passed inline in `OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT`: the gateway's base URL with `/v1`, the key as `{env:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY}` and the model declared, so an id outside its catalog works.
notes: `-c` on later turns continues the last session in this directory, and each platform session has its own directory, so continuation is reliable.
`PWD` is exported because OpenCode takes its directory from it rather than from `getcwd()`.
The `OPENCODE_DISABLE_*` switches stop model fetching, autoupdate, LSP downloads and the embedded web UI.
For an OpenAI Responses provider use provider id `openai` and no `/v1` suffix; for a chat provider, a custom provider with `npm: @ai-sdk/openai-compatible`.
